O.content: The chart shows a case-count line and axis labels, but no printed routing threshold, alert cutoff, or escalation policy criterion is visible.

B.text: If routing requires an explicit policy threshold or sustained-trend criterion beyond the general instruction to select the pathway that best matches the observed trajectory, the chart alone does not provide that threshold; background monitoring could be retained pending such a criterion.
B.conditions: Applies only if an unstated escalation policy threshold is required; no such threshold is supplied in the task materials.

O.content: The blue line and markers generally move lower on the page from left to right.

B.text: If chart geometry is interpreted by the usual upward-is-higher convention despite the printed Count tick ordering, the line's downward screen movement would appear to represent a declining trajectory; under the task labels, a declining trajectory maps to declining-case stabilization review.
B.conditions: Only applies if the printed vertical tick labels are disregarded or treated as nonauthoritative.

O.content: The title reads "Month vs. Number of cases," and the vertical axis is labeled "Count."
Printed y-axis ticks show 0 near the top, then 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, and 1400 at progressively lower positions.
The leftmost blue marker is positioned close to the 0 tick, while the rightmost blue marker is below the 1400 tick.

O.location: horizontal axis and blue plotted series
O.content: The blue line runs from left to right across the dated horizontal labels and its markers generally move lower on the page.

B.text: If the horizontal labels encode the displayed reporting sequence from left to right, the vertical axis labeled "Count" uses its printed tick values, and larger printed values are lower on the page, then the line's movement from near the 0 tick at the left toward below the 1400 tick at the right encodes an increase in reported cases. For this task, an increasing reported-case trajectory maps to rising-case escalation follow-up.
B.conditions: Applies to the plotted blue case-count series and assumes the printed Count ticks, rather than conventional upward chart geometry, define the metric direction.
